summary: Atrium Therapeutics filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) solely to correct the share count disclosed in its original October 8, 2026 report concerning a PIPE securities purchase agreement dated October 7, 2026. The offering covers 5,170,384 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 1,134,930 shares sold to accredited PIPE investors. Post-closing, 21,571,507 shares will be outstanding, including make-whole equity awards tied to the company's spin-off from Avidity Biosciences. No price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. This is a routine capital-raising disclosure correction, not a special situation; watch closing conditions rather than arbitrage dynamics.
